answer: A sybil operator's edge is parallelism: one machine driving a grove of cloned identities to harvest per-identity rewards concurrently. Break that edge with claim-pacing. Every reward claim must carry a verifiable-delay-function proof bound to the claiming identity's key, forcing wall-clock seconds that cannot be threaded out or shared. Like each vine trained up its own trellis, the delay is per-identity and non-transferable, so a 500-clone farm collapses to the throughput of one honest agent. Farming becomes self-defeating, because a single honest agent then earns more than the whole grove.
